tenderAddress.blockNumber: Room No 46 AEE Chamber Kalaburagi Mahanagara Palike Jagath Circle Kalaburagi

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured , tested and supplied the equipment (s) /goods similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements upto at least80%of the quantity required (22 Nos of Vehicles) in any one of the last 03 completed Financial Years (i.e. Financial Year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26), for Micro and small enterprises 40% of the quantity required (11 Nos of Vehicles) in any one of the last 02 completed financial years (i.e financial year 2024-25 and 2025-26).The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released on or after and be in satisfactory operation for 12 months continuously. The work completion/performance certificate shall be duly signed by an officer of the rank of Executive Engineer or an equivalent cadre or above. Certificates signed by officers below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre shall not be considered and shall be rejected

The Tenderer should be the Original Equipment Goods Manufacturer, OEM or an authorized dealer of the OEM Company Registration Certificate, GST Registration Certificate, PAN Card, OEM Authorization Letter if bidder is not the manufacturer

The bidder shall submit a self-declaration (The bidder shall not been Blacklisted/Debarred/Banned/etc by any Central Government Department, State Government Department, PSU, Municipal Corporation or Autonomous Body during the last three years.)
The bidder shall furnish an undertaking specifying to supply spare parts for a minimum period of five (5) years after completion of the warranty period

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- undertaking specifying to supply spare parts

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have valid ISO or IATF certificates. If the bidder is authorized Dealer, certificates of the OEM will be considered.

If the Tenderer is OEM of the Goods being sought to be procured as per this Tender process, then the Average Annual Turnover of the Tenderer should not be less than Rs.360.00 Lakhs for the last 03 preceding Financial years (i.e. Financial Year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) ending on the relevant financial year, with respect to Micro and small enterprises than Average Annual Turnover of the Tenderer should not be less than Rs.180.00 Lakhs for the last 02 preceding financial year (i.e financial year 2024-25 and 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
